dialogues.speaker: Yuften
dialogues.text: I—is there something you n—need today? I h—heard you went to Gurabad... I—it is a shame that the J—Jinni can no longer speak.

dialogues.speaker: Yuften
dialogues.text: But seeing you r—return unharmed is a blessing...

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: Planting crops and f—feeding the fish. Sometimes, I also do some b—b—butchery. Crocodile skin and meat is v—very useful.

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: We get clean spring water all year around h—here, so it's just right for raising crocodiles. Th—that's why we fenced this place up.

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: Crocodiles are easy to care for, and they can be harvested for lots of skins and meat. Unfortunately, f—fields are a d—different story...

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: We do... but only for testing. Matriarch Babel invited some outsiders to c—c—come and provide us with Anahitian Blessing, and she got all these old books from the city...

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: S—s—so we've tried our hand at farming according to the contents of these books.

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: But the oases in the canyon are too narrow and lack nutrients. We need to find a way to f—fertilize the soil.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Tell me about the Anahitian Blessing...

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: The outsiders didn't want to reveal the fertilizer's composition. As such, we've had to rely on the people who provide it to f—fertilize the soil... which isn't good.

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: Th—that's why the Matriarch wants me to d—do some research here to r—reverse engineer our own Anahitian Blessing.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I shan't disturb you any longer.

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: Th—that's alright. Please take some crocodile jerky, dear guest. It's just over there...

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: Hehe, yes. I—I take care of them. These are quite large and obedient...

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: This one's c—c—called Sedim. Very fierce and strong, and skin's very vibrant. It'll make for a good satchel. And there's that one, Karam. It's small but plump. Rather gentle, too.
